WSDL11-part-element.reason: The message part references a missing global echo wrapper. The whole-schema pattern generator did not add its wrapper. A schema-valid underlying feature does not make this generated WSDL valid.

XML10-empty-document.reason: The authoritative Imported.xsd resource is zero bytes and has no document element; HTTP metadata and exact bytes are pinned in corpus/catalog.json. No substitute schema is supplied.

XSD10-ENTITY.reason: ENTITY and ENTITIES require unparsed entities declared in the instance DTD. The fixtures name lt/gt/apos/quot without unparsed declarations; predefined parsed entities do not qualify. SOAP documents cannot gain validity by adding a prohibited DTD.

XSD10-IDREF.reason: The IDREF/IDREFS values have no matching ID in the document. Xerces rejects them with cvc-id.1; libxml2 accepts them. Track negative validation coverage in P5, including requests and responses.

XSD10-arbitrary-number.reason: These decimal/integer literals are valid values. libxml2 rejects values beyond its numeric representation limit. The specification permits documented implementation precision limits for minimally conforming validators; this is an oracle limitation, not proof of invalid input. Exact lexical/value assertions remain required in P3.

XSD10-attribute-owner.reason: The gender attribute belongs on the extended complex value, not the nested name element declared with simple type xs:string.

XSD10-element-content.reason: The localElementSimpleType value requires a localElement child; the source supplies scalar text instead of that child.

XSD10-gMonth.reason: The second-edition gMonth syntax is --MM followed by an optional valid timezone; trailing -- was removed by erratum E2-12. A -15:00 timezone exceeds the permitted +/-14:00 bound. Xerces accepts the obsolete trailing -- spelling; the normative assertion rejects it.

XSD10-global-attribute.reason: A ref to a global attribute in the target namespace requires that expanded attribute name. The fixture instead supplies an unqualified attribute.

XSD10-occurrence.reason: The MinOccurs1 fixture has two value elements although its particle has default maxOccurs=1.

XSD10-payload.reason: Payload validity is assessed against declarations in each schema. Agreement supports this finding; protocol and value preservation remain separate checks.

XSD10-schema.reason: Schema construction and component constraints are checked against the WSDL inline schema as well as the separately supplied echo schema.

XSD10-schema-content.reason: ImportTypesNamespace puts a foreign wsdl element containing schemas inside xs:schema, outside its allowed content. Its echo reference also spells importTypesNamesapce while the inner declaration is importTypesNamespace in a different namespace.

XSD10-strict-wildcard.reason: processContents=strict requires a matching declaration. These other-namespace element/attribute instances have no matching declarations or supplied imports.

XSD10-unresolved-ref.reason: The echo wrapper references an element in the primary target namespace that is not declared anywhere in the pinned schema graph. The declared imports do not provide that element.

XSD10-unsigned-lexical.reason: XSD 1.0 unsignedLong/Int/Short/Byte lexical forms consist of digits without a sign. Both -0 and +42 are invalid here. The nonNegativeInteger base permits signs; XSD 1.1 changes the unsigned lexical rule. Xerces-J 2.12.2 accepts the signed forms; that acceptance does not override the selected XSD 1.0 text.
